security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Installs and updates the Xenify apps
bundle.longDescription: Installs Xenify Write, Draw, Chat and the Xenify server, keeps them up to date on the channel you pick, and lets you go back a version. Every download is checked against Xenify's signature.
